item: Row 288 batch 3: 96 more test files open their SQLite engines with the app's pragmas
summary: 122 bare create_engine calls in 96 test files (none touched by an open PR) now go through tests/_app_engine.py::app_sqlite_engine, so they run with the app's foreign keys, WAL, busy timeout and cache settings; the converted files and every test file importing one of them pass. Held back and reported to Plan, not reshaped: test_incremental_vacuum_shortfall.py, whose reader-blocked test pins that a held read snapshot makes incremental_vacuum raise; on a WAL store, the app's own mode, the vacuum instead reclaims every page (445 of 445), so the measurement behind the residual wording in src/database/maintenance.py::maybe_incremental_vacuum holds only for a rollback-journal store. The ratchet ceiling goes from 609 to 487 calls in 353 files. Test-only, no release line.
